text:
Marta Reyes: Thanks for the transparency in today's all-hands. Starting a compact thread to collect follow-ups on the reliability update and RCA link. recording + slides: https://notion.redwood/internals/allhands/2026-03-25 :pushpin:
Liam O'Connor: RCA? I want to forward to a partner that's concerned about latency impact.
Marta Reyes: RCA posted here: https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-25-routing-loop 12 TL;DR in the first paragraph.
Nora (Eng Lead): Short summary: transient routing loop amplified KV reads under a rare timing window. Hotfix rolled (short-circuit + rate cap) and canary underway. Full timeline + traces in the RCA.
Avery Kim: Leadership Q: if this is a timing window, can load shaping at the edge reduce risk without touching routing code?
Nora (Eng Lead): Edge shaping helps but doesn't eliminate the race. Short-term edge backpressure is a useful mitigation; long-term fix is routing guard + stricter canary controls.
Sam Torres: Action request: can we list owners and due dates so product and CS have clarity for customer comms?
Marta Reyes: I'll add a small register here. Edit if you own an item.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action 1 - finish canary and post regional latency graphs. Owner: Nora. Due: 2026-03-27.
Liam O'Connor: I'll forward graphs to partners once posted.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action 2 - instrument additional KV miss and inflight counters + add pager. Owner: Avery Kim. Due: 2026-04-05.
Avery Kim: Ack. I'll create dashboards and set pager at 8% sustained miss over 10m.
Marta Reyes: Action 3 - draft customer-facing note + single-PS contact. Owner: Marta & CS. Due: 2026-03-26 EOD.
Sam Torres: Action 4 - CI test to simulate the timing window so we don't regress. Owner: Sam. Due: 2026-04-02.
incident-bot: Incident RC-2026-03-25 status -> mitigated. RCA published: https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-25-routing-loop :white_check_mark:
Avery Kim: Small config snippet added in hotfix for transparency:
```
router.guard.short_circuit.enabled=true
router.guard.miss_threshold=0.10
router.guard.window_seconds=20
```
No schema changes.
Marta Reyes: For leadership: if canary is green by 3/27, do we still want to pull the routing-hardening task forward?
Liam O'Connor: My vote is yes 10 accelerate one sprint to reduce customer risk.
Nora (Eng Lead): I'll propose reprioritization in next roadmap sync. Thanks everyone 14 please update the RCA page with any follow-ups and mark actions done when complete.
